data.name: Sample - Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed - 1.0.0
data.description: The Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed connector ingests indicators-including IP addresses, domains, URLs, hashes, and vulnerabilities-from Recorded Future Connect API risklists. It also supports on-demand reputation lookups.

workflows.name: Lookup Domain
workflows.description: Perform an on-demand reputation lookup for the specified domain and retrieve associated threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Lookup Domain

workflows.name: Lookup IP
workflows.description: Perform an on-demand reputation lookup for the specified IP address and retrieve associated threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Lookup IP

workflows.name: Lookup Vulnerability (CVE)
workflows.description: Perform an on-demand reputation lookup for the specified CVE identifier and retrieve associated threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Lookup Vulnerability (CVE)

workflows.name: Lookup URL
workflows.description: Perform an on-demand reputation lookup for the specified URL and retrieve associated threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Lookup URL

workflows.name: Get Risk Rules
workflows.description: Retrieve the list of available risk rules for the specified indicator type.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Get Risk Rules

workflows.name: Lookup Hash
workflows.description: Perform an on-demand reputation lookup for the specified file hash (MD5, SHA1, or SHA256) and retrieve associated threat intelligence details from Recorded Future.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Lookup Hash

workflows.name: Fetch Indicators
workflows.description: Fetch indicators of the specified type from the Recorded Future risklist. This action can be used for both scheduled data ingestion and on-demand retrieval.

arguments.title: Recorded Future Threat Intel Feed: Fetch Indicators

workflows.name: > Recorded Future > Fetch and Create
workflows.description: Fetch and Create indicators from Recorded Future. Called as a child workflow from the Ingest orchestrator.

arguments.reputation_map: {'Good': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Good') }}, 'Malicious': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Malicious') }}, 'Suspicious': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Suspicious') }}, 'TBD': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('TBD') }}, 'No Reputation Available': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('No Reputation Available') }}}
arguments.type_of_feed_map: {'ip': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('IPv4 Address') }}, 'domain': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('Domain') }}, 'url': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('URL') }}, 'hash': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('FileHash-SHA256') }}, 'vulnerability': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('CVE') }}}

resource.confidence: {% if vars.confidence %}{{ vars.confidence }}{% else %}{{ (vars.item.score | int) }}{% endif %}
resource.reputation: {% if vars.reputation %}{{ vars.reputation | resolveRange(vars.reputation_map) }}{% else %}None{% endif %}
resource.description: {% if vars.item.risk_string %}Recorded Future: {{vars.item.risk_string}}{% else %}Recorded Future indicator{% endif %}

step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
  {
    "title": "Indicator Type",
    "name": "indicator_type",
    "type": "select",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "options": [
      "IP",
      "Domain",
      "URL",
      "Hash",
      "Vulnerability"
    ],
    "value": "IP",
    "tooltip": "Recorded Future risklist to pull on each scheduled run."
  },
  {
    "title": "Risk Rule (Optional)",
    "name": "risk_rule",
    "type": "text",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "tooltip": "Optional risk rule name. Leave blank for the default master risklist."
  },
  {
    "title": "Reputation",
    "name": "reputation",
    "type": "select",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "options": [
      "Good",
      "Suspicious",
      "Malicious",
      "No Reputation Available",
      "TBD"
    ],
    "value": "Suspicious"
  },
  {
    "title": "TLP",
    "name": "tlp",
    "type": "select",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "options": [
      "Red",
      "Amber",
      "Green",
      "White"
    ],
    "value": "Amber"
  },
  {
    "title": "Confidence (Override)",
    "name": "confidence",
    "type": "integer",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": 75,
    "validation": {
      "minlength": 0,
      "maxlength": 100
    },
    "tooltip": "If set, overrides the per-indicator score-derived confidence."
  },
  {
    "title": "Maximum Age (in days)",
    "name": "expiry",
    "type": "integer",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": 30
  },
  {
    "title": "Per-Run Limit (Optional)",
    "name": "limit",
    "type": "integer",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true
  }
]
